raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "employ"
  role subject "Atelier Müller"
  role object "Meera"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "employ"
    role subject "Atelier Müller"
    role object ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?x "Meera"
